segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ בּוֹזְקִין מֶלַח עַל גַּבֵּי כֶּבֶשׁ בִּשְׁבִיל שֶׁלֹּא יַחְלִיקוּ, וּמְמַלְּאִין מִבּוֹר הַגּוֹלָה וּמִבּוֹר הַגָּדוֹל בַּגַּלְגַּל בַּשַּׁבָּת, וּמִבְּאֵר הַקַּר בְּיוֹם טוֹב.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One» may «scatter salt» on Shabbat «on» the «ramp» that leads to the altar «so that» the priests will «not slip» on their way up. «And» likewise, «one» may «draw water from the Cistern of the Exiles and from the Great Cistern,» which were located in the Temple, «by» means of «the wheel» designed for drawing water, even «on Shabbat. And» one may draw water «from the Heker Well» only «on a Festival.»

moves.summary: Salt on the ramp and drawing water permitted on Shabbat in the Temple

positions.claim: salt may be scattered on the ramp and water drawn with a wheel from the Temple cisterns on Shabbat; from the Heker well only on a Festival
